sources.supportingExcerpt: Mexico does not recognize Kosovo passports.

unresolved.reason: Mexico's current official consular guidance says Kosovo passports are not recognized and a Mexican visa or entry is not possible. The available taxonomy has no entry_prohibited status, so this cannot be normalized as the fallback visa_required category.
